proposals.change_target: make all ten dense fullness cells survive 700px rasterization without overlapping card outlines
proposals.cause: V39 widened the dense meter to 11.83px but retained subpixel gaps and nearly zero card spacing; the Gate measured only three bright raster runs at full progress and geometric overlap between 0.7–1.5px outlines across a 0.103px gap.
proposals.candidate_change: Restore the already-passing v38 geometry for 10/28 rosters. Only above 20 columns, inset internal card edges by 0.3px, reduce state strokes to at most 0.6px, and use a dense ten-cell symbol whose roughly 1px adjacent cells alternate opacity so every cell boundary survives even when the 0.1px physical gap rasterizes away. Keep at least 11.5px of meter width and the 4.5px label floor.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The v39 Gate inspected actual pixels rather than only DOM geometry: a nominal ten-rect full meter produced three bright runs, and card strokes overlapped. Alternating adjacent one-pixel cells supplies a raster-visible boundary independent of subpixel whitespace, while edge insets make the maximum dense stroke smaller than the remaining card gap.
proposals.reproduction: At native 700px inspect and pixel-sample full 62-roster meters in dark and light: each must expose ten alternating cell runs, two-digit labels, and nonoverlapping card/state boundaries. Then inspect 10/28 unchanged geometry, 3x identity placement, reduced motion, meter progress, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps continuity under a fresh Gate.
proposals.primary_metric: A full 62-roster meter produces ten distinguishable raster cells at native 700px and adjacent dense card outlines do not geometrically overlap, while all sparse and motion guardrails remain unchanged.
proposals.prediction: Encoding cell boundaries with alternating one-pixel luminance instead of subpixel whitespace and insetting dense outlines will clear both measured v39 blockers without adding width, rows, or motion.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if a full dense meter produces fewer than ten visually distinct native-resolution cells; dense base or state outlines overlap; labels or tags disappear; 10/28 geometry changes; cards clip or lose x=212–650 endpoints; identity mapping, ear attachment, bite progress, selected meter, handoff, continuity, themes, reduced motion, finale, size, runtime, or npm run check regresses.
